BiblicalUsage: Amen, firm, trustworthy, surely — and the word is the seal on everything God has said. When the curses of the law are read, all the people say Amen, and when David's psalm of thanks ends, all the people say Amen and praise the LORD; and when David names Solomon his heir, Benaiah answers Amen, the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Amen is the shortest creed in the Bible, and the whole faith fits in it: God has spoken, and my answer is Amen. The people say it together because the word belongs to all of us, and I hold that every Amen I say is a small act of trust, that what God promised He will do.
